senses.gloss: f. = h. מוּרְבִּית I, a growing tree (not yet fully developed).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 1:6:3">Y. Shebi. I, end, 33ᶜ</cite>. <he>ואנן חמיי הדא מ׳ … אתיא בפירי</he> (not <he>בפורי</he>) and yet we see young fig trees come out with full fruit; [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:3:5">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵃ</cite>. <he>הדין מרויתא … לעוביה …</he>, a corrupt gloss transferred from Y. Shebi. l. c.].
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 2:17">Targ. Prov. II, 17</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02495"><he>מַרְבְּיָינָא</he></cite>.
